ux.l4a.panel.label: Help
ux.l4a.panel.heading: Help · {title}
ux.l4a.panel.open: Help and ask about this screen (?)
ux.l4a.panel.resize: Drag to make help wider or narrower
ux.l4a.panel.searchPlaceholder: A few words, like working folder
ux.l4a.panel.noResults: Nothing in the help matches that. Try other words, or tell us below what you were looking for.
ux.l4a.panel.searchFailed: Help search is not answering right now.
ux.l4a.panel.noEngine: Connect an engine to ask questions here.
ux.l4a.shortcut.helpQuestionContext: When you are not typing in a box
ux.l4a.feedback.open: Tell us what to make easier
ux.l4a.feedback.wordsLabel: Anything that felt complicated, anything you couldn't do, or anything you couldn't find.
ux.l4a.feedback.wordsNext: Feedback by words comes in the next update.
ux.l4a.feedback.needChoice: Pick one first, then press Send.
ux.l4a.feedback.pickFirst: Pick one above to see what we send.
ux.l4a.feedback.privacy: We send this screen's name and what it shows. Never your messages, files, keys or memory.
ux.l4a.feedback.added: Murage also adds this app's version, your computer's system and a random number for this install, so we can tell reports apart.
ux.l4a.feedback.sending: Sending. This takes a few seconds at most.
ux.l4a.feedback.sent: Thanks. This helps us make Murage clearer.
ux.l4a.feedback.failed: Could not send right now. Your note is kept here; try again later.
ux.l4a.feedback.tooMany: Not sent yet. You have sent a few in a short time. Wait a minute and press Send again.
ux.l4a.screen.today.title: Today
ux.l4a.screen.today.intro: What your bots did, what is waiting on you and what is coming. Nothing here is a setting; every card opens the place it came from.
ux.l4a.screen.today.tip1: Needs you holds anything waiting on your answer, oldest first.
ux.l4a.screen.today.tip2: Working now shows any bot mid-task, with Stop one click away.
ux.l4a.screen.today.tip3: Tell any bot what to do on a schedule and it becomes a routine.
ux.l4a.screen.today.why: One place to see the day without opening every chat.
ux.l4a.screen.chats.title: Chats
ux.l4a.screen.chats.intro: Every chat with every bot, plus projects and channels.
ux.l4a.screen.chats.tip1: {mod} K opens any bot or chat by name.
ux.l4a.screen.chats.tip2: A project keeps a group of bots on one job.
ux.l4a.screen.chats.tip3: {mod} Shift K opens this list from anywhere.
ux.l4a.screen.chats.why: Find an old chat without remembering which bot it was with.
ux.l4a.screen.chat.title: {name}
ux.l4a.screen.chat.intro: {name} drafts and asks. A card is a draft: nothing happens until you press its button.
ux.l4a.screen.chat.tip1: The chip next to the send arrow is {name}'s level.
ux.l4a.screen.chat.tip2: Type @ to bring another bot into this chat.
ux.l4a.screen.chat.tip3: {mod} F finds words anywhere in this chat.
ux.l4a.screen.chat.why: Where you give a bot work and answer what it asks.
ux.l4a.screen.group.title: {name}
ux.l4a.screen.group.intro: A shared chat where several bots work on the same thing with you.
ux.l4a.screen.group.tip1: Type @ and a bot's name to ask that bot.
ux.l4a.screen.group.tip2: Each bot keeps its own level here.
ux.l4a.screen.group.why: Keeps one job and the bots on it in one place.
ux.l4a.screen.needs-you.title: Needs you
ux.l4a.screen.needs-you.intro: Everything waiting on an answer. Open a row to see the whole card before you answer.
ux.l4a.screen.needs-you.tip1: Enter opens, 1 to 9 picks an option, Esc closes.
ux.l4a.screen.needs-you.tip2: Use the bot chips to answer one bot at a time.
ux.l4a.screen.needs-you.tip3: "Remind me at 17:00" hides a card; it still waits for you.
ux.l4a.screen.needs-you.why: Nothing a bot asked gets lost in a chat.
ux.l4a.screen.routines.title: Routines
ux.l4a.screen.routines.intro: Things your bots do on a schedule. Click a routine or a mark to open it.
ux.l4a.screen.routines.tip1: Ask a bot in words to do something on a schedule.
ux.l4a.screen.routines.tip2: Open a routine to run it now, pause it or change when it runs.
ux.l4a.screen.routines.tip3: Routines follow their bot's level unless you give one its own.
ux.l4a.screen.routines.why: See every scheduled job in one week.
ux.l4a.screen.routine.title: Routine
ux.l4a.screen.routine.intro: One routine: when it runs, what it does and how its last runs went.
ux.l4a.screen.routine.tip1: Run it now to see what it does before the next time.
ux.l4a.screen.routine.tip2: A run that stopped says why. Open it to see.
ux.l4a.screen.routine.why: Change one scheduled job without hunting for it.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.title: {name} settings
ux.l4a.screen.bot.intro: Everything about {name}: who it is, what it may do and what it remembers.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.tip1: Permissions sets how often {name} asks before acting.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.tip2: Access sets {name}'s working folder and apps.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.tip3: Changes save as you make them.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.why: One place for one bot's settings.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.overview.title: {name} · Overview
ux.l4a.screen.bot.overview.intro: {name}'s role, its team and a summary of how it is set up.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.overview.tip1: The role decides who {name} can reach and who can reach it.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.overview.why: A quick read of one bot before you change anything.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.identity.title: {name} · Identity & instructions
ux.l4a.screen.bot.identity.intro: {name}'s name, picture, personality and the standing instructions it follows.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.identity.tip1: Say what the job is in plain words; {name} reads it every time.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.identity.why: Tell a bot who it is and how to work.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.shapes.title: {name} · What shapes this bot
ux.l4a.screen.bot.shapes.intro: Everything {name} reads before it answers, in the order it reads it.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.shapes.tip1: House rules come first and every bot follows them.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.shapes.why: See why a bot behaves the way it does.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.skills.title: {name} · Skills
ux.l4a.screen.bot.skills.intro: Step-by-step know-how {name} can use, from the library or learned from you.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.skills.tip1: Turn a skill off to keep it without {name} using it.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.skills.why: Give a bot know-how it can reuse.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.learning.title: {name} · Learning
ux.l4a.screen.bot.learning.intro: What {name} learned from your feedback, and what you can undo.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.learning.tip1: Use the chip under a reply to tell {name} what worked.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.learning.why: See and undo what a bot learned.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.memory.title: {name} · Memory
ux.l4a.screen.bot.memory.tip1: Delete a memory and {name} stops using it.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.memory.why: Check and correct what a bot remembers.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.routines.title: {name} · Routines
ux.l4a.screen.bot.routines.tip1: Pause a routine here; it stays until you turn it back on.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.routines.why: One bot's scheduled jobs in one list.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.teams.title: {name} · Teams
ux.l4a.screen.bot.teams.intro: The teams {name} belongs to and the notes it shares with them.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.teams.tip1: A team's notes reach every bot on it.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.teams.why: Share know-how across a group of bots.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.access.title: {name} · Access
ux.l4a.screen.bot.access.intro: Where {name} may work: its folder, the computer, the browser and connected apps.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.access.tip1: {name} works inside its working folder unless you allow more.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.access.tip2: Connected apps are off for a bot until you turn them on.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.access.why: Decide what a bot can reach.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.email.title: {name} · Email
ux.l4a.screen.bot.email.intro: {name}'s own email address, who it may write to and what it sent.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.email.tip1: Pause sending here at any time.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.email.why: Let a bot send and receive email of its own.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.model.title: {name} · Model
ux.l4a.screen.bot.model.intro: The engine and model {name} thinks with, and how hard it thinks.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.model.tip1: A lighter model is quicker and costs less for simple jobs.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.model.why: Match a bot's thinking to its job.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.permissions.title: {name} · Permissions
ux.l4a.screen.bot.permissions.intro: How often {name} asks before it acts: Ask, Auto, Full access or No limits.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.permissions.tip1: Ask checks with you first; Auto asks only for bigger steps.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.permissions.tip2: Paying and reading your keys always ask, at every level.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.permissions.why: Decide how much a bot does without asking.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.voice.title: {name} · Voice & alerts
ux.l4a.screen.bot.voice.intro: How {name} sounds and when it lets you know something.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.voice.tip1: Turn on spoken replies to hear {name} answer.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.voice.why: Choose how a bot gets your attention.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.history.title: {name} · History
ux.l4a.screen.bot.history.intro: Every chat and task {name} has had.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.history.tip1: Open any past chat to pick it up again.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.history.why: Find an old chat with one bot.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.usage.title: {name} · Usage
ux.l4a.screen.bot.usage.intro: How much {name} has used this month.
ux.l4a.screen.bot.usage.tip1: Your own keys and sign-ins show up with those services, not here.
ux.l4a.screen.new.title: New
ux.l4a.screen.new.intro: Start something: a bot, a chat, a project or a channel.
ux.l4a.screen.new.tip1: {mod} N makes a new bot from anywhere.
ux.l4a.screen.new.why: One door for everything you can start.
ux.l4a.screen.new-bot.title: New bot
ux.l4a.screen.new-bot.intro: Say what the new bot should do. Murage sets it up for you to check.
ux.l4a.screen.new-bot.tip1: You can change anything about a bot later in its settings.
ux.l4a.screen.new-bot.tip2: A new bot starts on Ask, so it checks with you first.
ux.l4a.screen.new-bot.why: Hire a bot without learning settings first.
ux.l4a.screen.connect-app.title: Connect an app
ux.l4a.screen.connect-app.intro: Sign in to an app so a bot can use it for you.
ux.l4a.screen.connect-app.tip1: You sign in on the app's own page. Murage keeps the login on this computer.
ux.l4a.screen.connect-app.tip2: Each bot needs its own yes before it uses the app.
ux.l4a.screen.connect-app.why: Let a bot work in Gmail, Slack and other apps.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.general.title: Settings · General
ux.l4a.screen.settings.general.intro: Every setting is here, on or off. Type a word to find one. A card that is off says why and what turns it on.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.general.tip1: Type any word in the search box to land on its setting.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.general.tip2: This page holds your name, the app's look and its language.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.general.why: Your profile and how the app looks and behaves.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.botDefaults.title: Settings · Bots
ux.l4a.screen.settings.botDefaults.intro: How new bots start, the house rules every bot follows, and how bots take turns.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.botDefaults.tip1: House rules apply to every bot, old and new.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.botDefaults.why: Set the starting point for every bot.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.skills.title: Settings · Skills
ux.l4a.screen.settings.skills.intro: Know-how your bots can use, like step-by-step guides.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.skills.tip1: Look through a skill before you give it to a bot.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.skills.why: Manage the know-how every bot can draw on.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.memory.title: Settings · Memory
ux.l4a.screen.settings.memory.intro: What your bots remember between conversations.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.memory.tip1: Each bot's own memory is in that bot's settings.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.memory.why: Decide how much your bots remember.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.models.title: Settings · Models & engines
ux.l4a.screen.settings.models.intro: The AI models your bots think with, the programs that run them, and the keys that pay for them.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.models.tip1: Flux Router gives every bot a model with one sign-in.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.models.tip2: Engines lists the programs on this computer that can run a bot.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.models.why: Give your bots something to think with.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.webSearch.title: Settings · Tools
ux.l4a.screen.settings.webSearch.intro: Web search, pictures and voice for your bots.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.webSearch.tip1: Turn on web search to let bots look things up.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.webSearch.why: Extra things your bots can do.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.connections.title: Settings · Connected apps
ux.l4a.screen.settings.connections.intro: Let bots use Gmail, Slack, Notion and other apps.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.connections.tip1: Connect an app once, then give each bot its own yes.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.connections.why: One list of every app your bots can use.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.channels.title: Settings · Messaging apps
ux.l4a.screen.settings.channels.intro: Talk to your bots from Telegram, Slack or Discord.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.channels.tip1: Messages there reach your Chief of Staff first.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.channels.why: Reach your bots without opening Murage.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.companion.title: Settings · Devices
ux.l4a.screen.settings.companion.intro: Use Murage on your phone and other devices, and the computer and browser your bots can use.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.companion.tip1: Pair your phone to answer bots when you are away.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.companion.why: Murage on your phone, and your bots on a computer.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.backups.title: Settings · Backups
ux.l4a.screen.settings.backups.intro: Keep a copy of everything, and get it back if you need to.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.backups.tip1: A backup you have restored once is one you can trust.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.backups.why: Nothing is lost if this computer is.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.usage.title: Settings · Usage
ux.l4a.screen.settings.usage.intro: What your bots used this month. Money shows when Flux Router is connected.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.usage.tip1: Your own keys and sign-ins show up with those services, not here.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.usage.tip2: Open a bot to see what it used on its own.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.about.title: Settings · About & updates
ux.l4a.screen.settings.about.intro: Updates, news from us, and help.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.about.tip1: Murage checks for updates and tells you before it installs one.
ux.l4a.screen.settings.about.why: Which version you have and what is new.
ux.l4a.screen.help.title: Help
ux.l4a.screen.help.intro: Tips for the screen you are on, the help pages, and a way to tell us what to make easier.
ux.l4a.screen.help.tip1: {mod} / opens help from anywhere, even while typing.
ux.l4a.screen.help.why: The answer to "how do I" is always one key away.
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.hello.title: Getting set up · who you are
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.hello.intro: Your Chief of Staff says hello and asks your name, so every bot knows who it works for.
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.hello.tip1: Answer in the chat; you can change it later in Settings.
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.hello.tip2: Close the list at the top whenever you like. Nothing in it stops you.
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.hello.why: What Murage is: bots that work for you, one chat at a time.
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.detect.title: Getting set up · what is here
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.detect.intro: Murage looks at what this computer already has that a bot can think with.
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.detect.tip1: Anything found is connected for you; nothing to change.
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.detect.why: Use what you already have before asking for more.
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flux.title: Getting set up · switch it on
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flux.intro: Flux Router gives your bots a model to think with, with one sign-in.
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flux.tip1: You can pass on this and connect your own engine later.
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flux.why: Bots need something to think with before they can answer.
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.chat.title: Getting set up · first chat
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.chat.intro: Ask your Chief of Staff for something small and watch it work.
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.chat.tip1: A card that asks is a draft. Nothing happens until you press its button.
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.chat.why: See a bot do real work in the first few minutes.
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flow.title: Getting set up · do the thing
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flow.intro: Give a bot a real job, or ask for one on a schedule.
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flow.tip1: Say "every morning" and the job becomes a routine.
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flow.why: Leave set-up with one job already running.
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.strip.title: Getting set up
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.strip.intro: The list at the top shows where you have got to in setting up.
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.strip.tip1: Close the list whenever you like; it stays in your chat.
ux.l4a.screen.first-run.strip.why: Shows what is left without ever blocking you.
ux.l4a.screen.phone-setup.title: Pair your phone
ux.l4a.screen.phone-setup.intro: Use Murage on your phone, through this computer.
ux.l4a.screen.phone-setup.tip1: This computer has to be on and online for the phone to reach it.
ux.l4a.screen.phone-setup.why: Answer your bots when you are away from your desk.
ux.l4a.screen.cloud.title: Murage Cloud
ux.l4a.screen.cloud.intro: Your bots, running on a computer of their own online, reached from any browser.
ux.l4a.screen.cloud.tip1: Everything you do here happens on your Cloud home, not this device.
ux.l4a.screen.cloud.why: Your bots keep working when your own computer is off.
ux.l4a.screen.files.title: Files
ux.l4a.screen.files.intro: The files in this bot's working folder.
ux.l4a.screen.files.tip1: Click a file to preview it beside the chat.
ux.l4a.screen.files.why: See what a bot made without leaving the chat.
ux.l4a.screen.map.title: Team map
ux.l4a.screen.map.intro: Who works with whom: every bot, its role and who it can reach.
ux.l4a.screen.map.tip1: Click a bot to open its chat.
ux.l4a.screen.map.why: See how your bots work together at a glance.
ux.l4a.screen.apps.title: Connected apps
ux.l4a.screen.apps.intro: Apps your bots can use for you, like Gmail, Slack and Notion.
ux.l4a.screen.apps.tip1: Connect an app once, then give each bot its own yes.
ux.l4a.screen.apps.tip2: Disconnect an app here and no bot can use it.
ux.l4a.screen.apps.why: One place to see every app your bots can reach.
ux.l4a.screen.skill-recorder.title: Teach a skill
ux.l4a.screen.skill-recorder.intro: Show a bot how you do something once. Murage writes it up as a skill for you to check.
ux.l4a.screen.skill-recorder.tip1: Look through the skill before any bot uses it.
ux.l4a.screen.skill-recorder.why: Teach by showing instead of writing instructions.
ux.l4a.screen.computer.title: Computer
ux.l4a.screen.computer.intro: The screen and browser this bot is using, live.
ux.l4a.screen.computer.tip1: Take over at any time; the bot waits until you hand back.
ux.l4a.screen.computer.why: Watch a bot work on a computer, and step in.
ux.l4a.screen.inspector.title: Inspector
ux.l4a.screen.inspector.intro: Every step this bot took in this chat, in order.
ux.l4a.screen.inspector.tip1: Useful when a bot did something you did not expect.
ux.l4a.screen.inspector.why: See exactly what a bot did.
ux.l4a.screen.no-engines.title: Nothing to think with yet
ux.l4a.screen.no-engines.intro: Your bots need an engine before they can answer. Connect one and they start at once.
ux.l4a.screen.no-engines.tip1: Flux Router is the quickest way: one sign-in, every model.
ux.l4a.screen.no-engines.why: Get a bot answering in a few minutes.
ux.l4a.screen.rail-fold.title: More bots
ux.l4a.screen.rail-fold.intro: Bots you have not used lately, folded so the list stays short.
ux.l4a.screen.rail-fold.tip1: The fold row still shows which hidden bots are working or need you.
ux.l4a.screen.rail-fold.why: A long list of bots stays easy to scan.
ux.l4a.screen.client-header.title: Client workspace
ux.l4a.screen.client-header.intro: You are looking at a client's workspace. Everything here belongs to that client.
ux.l4a.screen.client-header.tip1: Switch back to your own workspace from the You menu.
ux.l4a.screen.client-header.why: Always know whose workspace you are in.
ux.l4a.screen.clients-card.title: Clients
ux.l4a.screen.clients-card.intro: Every client workspace, what it spent and what is waiting.
ux.l4a.screen.clients-card.tip1: Click a client to open its workspace.
ux.l4a.screen.clients-card.why: Look after every client from one place.
ux.l4a.screen.other-workspaces.title: Other workspaces
ux.l4a.screen.other-workspaces.intro: Clients with something waiting on you, beyond the workspace you are in.
ux.l4a.screen.other-workspaces.tip1: Click a client to see what it is waiting on.
ux.l4a.screen.other-workspaces.why: Nothing waiting in another workspace gets missed.
ux.l4a.screen.add-client.title: Add a client workspace
ux.l4a.screen.add-client.intro: Pair a client's Cloud home so you can look after it from here.
ux.l4a.screen.add-client.tip1: The client's bots and chats stay in their own workspace.
ux.l4a.screen.add-client.why: Run several clients from one desktop.
ux.l4a.gate.offline: Not connected to the computer running Murage
ux.l4a.gate.enginesOff: Engines are switched off in this copy
ux.l4a.feedback.notSupport: This goes to the Murage team to improve the app. It is not a help request, so nobody will reply here. Need help now? Ask your bot.
ux.l4a.feedback.tooLong: That is longer than we can take. Please shorten it, then press Send again.
